body:
Drafted by the #1040 fix element; red-team r1 reproduced it.

`read_file` catches `ArrowInvalid` from `pd.read_parquet` and falls through to `pd.read_csv`. A garbage `var/household_roster.parquet` plus `Country('Albania', assume_cache_fresh=True)._aggregate_wave_data(all_waves, 'household_roster')` returns a **0-row frame with no warning**. This is pinned as found in `tests/test_gh1040_wave_read_gates.py::test_site3_read_error`.

The `.dta` suffix already refuses this fallback ("has a .dta suffix but no Stata header"); a `.parquet` should do the same and raise a typed error. The fix moves that pin on purpose.

**Cost.** Editing `get_dataframe` moves every hash, so this should ride the pending corpus re-warm bundle (#805/#831, #928, #1040, #1045, #1066) rather than pay its own. Tier B.

comments.body: Fixed on `development` by PR #1105, the corpus bundle (merge `e87a551e8`). Left open until the release merge to `master`.

title: get_dataframe serves a non-parquet .parquet as an empty CSV frame; under assume_cache_fresh that becomes the served table
